description: This Java file defines the MidiPortConnector class, which provides utilities for connecting MIDI ports on remote devices via the Android MIDI API. It manages opening devices, connecting ports, and handling closure of connections.

classes.name: MidiPortConnector
classes.description: A utility class for establishing and managing MIDI port connections between two remote devices using Android's MIDI API.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes any open MIDI devices and connection, releasing resources.

methods.name: safeClose
methods.description: Attempts to close resources safely, catching and logging any IOExceptions.

methods.name: connectToDevicePort
methods.description: Overloaded method that initiates connection between specific ports on two MIDI devices, handling device opening and port connection asynchronously.
